sahneler.metin: Gas smells on purpose because this school exploded.
It collapsed with hundreds of children inside.
Nearly three hundred people died, most of them students.
So why did nobody notice the gas?
To save money, the school used raw, odorless gas, and it leaked.
One spark, likely from a shop sander, set it off.
Within weeks, Texas required gas to carry a warning smell.
Every time you smell gas today, that rule is protecting you.

aciklama:
On March 18, 1937, odorless gas leaking under the school in New London, Texas exploded, killing nearly 300 people. Texas then required gas to be odorized.
